description: Auralith router evaluation set. 60 hand-labelled requests, 20 per action. Labels follow the definitions in ROUTER_PROMPT (auralith/graph/nodes.py): SearchWeb = needs current or looked-up information; WriteCode = wants source code produced; Converse = everything else, including explaining code and writing prose.
labelling_notes: kind=clear: a reader of ROUTER_PROMPT would not hesitate.

kind=boundary: written to sit near a decision edge (e.g. a coding topic that only wants an explanation, or prose that looks like a generation task). Each has a note saying why the label is what it is.
Accuracy on clear and boundary items is reported separately, so a router that only fails boundary items is distinguishable from one that is broken.
